unresolved: n_models=18 combines 3 self-trained white-box models (LR, CNN, LSTM) with 15 black-box online platforms/APIs (10 sentiment + 5 toxic-content) that the paper explicitly counts; some black-box platforms (fastText, ParallelDots, Aylien) recur across the sentiment and toxic-content tasks as distinct deployed classifiers, so the true count of distinct architectures is smaller than 18 if counted by underlying model family instead of by deployed endpoint.

n_eval_types=11 is an aggregate across effectiveness/efficiency metrics (success rate, perturbed-word %, time), the four explicitly named utility metrics (edit distance, Jaccard, Euclidean distance, semantic similarity), transferability rate, human-study accuracy, and the two defense-evaluation success rates (spelling check, adversarial training); paper does not itself state a single total count of evaluation types.
reports_variability set to 'none' because the paper states only that it reports the mean over 5 repeats, with no std/CI/error bars given anywhere for the repeated-experiment variance.
